long_biography.plain_text:
Frenkel has lived in Florida since he was five. An economics degree in Gainesville and an MBA in Miami prepared him to oversee the complex holdings created by his parents' business success. He turned that responsibility into a professional platform for portfolio management, financial planning, and tax and estate coordination, later extending the model to other families. He also holds ownership interests in a registered adviser and a private-capital partnership.

Stewardship extends beyond finance. Frenkel helps direct his family's giving across medical care, education, Jewish institutions and programs for children. Through the regional Make-A-Wish organization, he advanced from board service to chairman while his relatives, foundation and company backed a new headquarters and long-term campaign. His operating and civic roles share one durable purpose: carrying capital, institutions and responsibility from one generation to the next.
